Sound on 🔊

New in Miami and no team? There are 3 ways in. 👇

1️⃣ Rec leagues: sign up solo and they put you on a team.
2️⃣ Club tryouts: clubs post them on Instagram, so follow the clubs near you.
3️⃣ Tell Cancha what you play and we'll send you clubs that fit.

Find me a team: link in bio. Free. 📲 Save this for when a friend moves here.

The app screens are illustrations.

#MiamiSoccer #BrowardSoccer #SouthFloridaSoccer #FindYourTeam #Cancha
